critical_finding: Teacher-Forced vs Free-Generation Disconnect: Under teacher forcing, the trained model achieved massive likelihood gains on held-out dev answers: Perplexity dropped from 372.76 to 92.13, and the correct first answer token's median rank improved from 216 down to 21. However, because the correct first token only reaches top-1 in 0.5% of cases (and top-10 in 23.5%), greedy autoregressive decoding immediately selects the highest unconditioned prior token (bracket '[' or '2000'), initiating an unrecoverable generation cascade.
